newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga says board approves Santa Fe deal.
newsitem.headline: Saga says board approves Santa Fe deal.

text.p: Norwegian oil company Saga Petroleum ASA said on Tuesday its supervisory board had approved the acquisition of North Sea exploration group Santa Fe Exploration Ltd.
The supervisory board met with Saga's management on Monday night to discuss the takeover of Santa Fe from state-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC).
"Saga Petroleum confirms that the company's supervisory board has approved the proposal for an agreement to buy North Sea Holdings Ltd (Santa Fe)," a statement from the company said.
Confirmation that Kuwait Petroleum Corp has formally accepted the deal is expected soon.
Market sources had expected Saga to announce a deal on Monday. The sources said the agreement had been finalised at $1.2 billion.
